Class PickerFreezePacket

All Implemented Interfaces:

public class PickerFreezePacket extends Object implements Payload
Client â†’ server: "freeze the mob I'm editing" (or release it). The freeze itself â€” NoAi capture, restore, crash-proofing â€” is owned by PickerFreezeService on the server, so it works from a remote client and survives that client disappearing; this packet only asks.

Freezing requires picker authorization (PickerGate.authorized(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer)). Unfreezing does not: it only releases the sender's own frozen mob, and gating it would strand a mob frozen if the player lost creative or operator status mid-edit.
